s0501.literal: Dadulu Dong'an Prefecture and Daming Route's Baima County suffered famine; all were granted relief.
s0501.idiomatic: Dadulu Dong'an Prefecture and Daming Route's Baima County suffered famine; all were granted relief.

s0502.literal: Second month, on guimao day, the wine prohibition in Bianliang Route was relaxed.
s0502.idiomatic: Second month, on guimao day, the wine prohibition in Bianliang Route was relaxed.

s0503.literal: On yimao day Yaji dispatched envoy Zanggu to present local products in tribute.
s0503.idiomatic: On yimao day Yaji dispatched envoy Zanggu to present local products in tribute.

s0504.literal: On gengshen day an edict directed the realm to change the era name to Zhihe.
s0504.idiomatic: On gengshen day an edict directed the realm to change the era name to Zhihe.

s0505.literal: Henan's self-assessed field grain tax was remitted for one year; tax grain in disaster-stricken prefectures and commanderies was remitted for one year; displaced persons who returned to their occupations had levies and taxes remitted for three years; all doubtful cases held in custody for three years without decision were released.
s0505.idiomatic: Henan's self-assessed field grain tax was remitted for 1 year; tax grain in disaster-stricken prefectures and commanderies was remitted for 1 year; displaced persons who returned to their occupations had levies and taxes remitted for 3 years; all doubtful cases held in custody for 3 years without decision were released.

s0506.literal: Prince of Liaoning Tuotuo was granted five thousand ingots of notes; Prince of Liang Wang Shan was granted two thousand ingots of notes.
s0506.idiomatic: Prince of Liaoning Tuotuo was granted 5,000 ingots of notes; Prince of Liang Wang Shan was granted 2,000 ingots of notes.

s0507.literal: On renxu day Venus appeared in the daytime.
s0507.idiomatic: On renxu day Venus appeared in the daytime.

s0508.literal: On guihai day the Heilong Dam of Jie Prefecture's salt ponds was damaged; Fanxiu salt laborers were mobilized to repair it.
s0508.idiomatic: On guihai day the Heilong Dam of Jie Prefecture's salt ponds was damaged; Fanxiu salt laborers were mobilized to repair it.

s0509.literal: Shaanxi's various routes suffered famine; fifty thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0509.idiomatic: Shaanxi's various routes suffered famine; 50,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

s0510.literal: Dependent counties of Hejian and Bianliang routes and the Mongol troops at Kaicheng and Qian Prefecture suffered famine; all were granted relief.
s0510.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Hejian and Bianliang routes and the Mongol troops at Kaicheng and Qian Prefecture suffered famine; all were granted relief.

s0511.literal: Third month, on gengwu day, one thousand Asud Guard soldiers on frontier garrison duty were each granted forty ingots of notes;
s0511.idiomatic: Third month, on gengwu day, 1,000 Asud Guard soldiers on frontier garrison duty were each granted 40 ingots of notes;

s0512.literal: Six thousand one hundred impoverished persons were each granted five shi of grain.
s0512.idiomatic: 6,100 impoverished persons were each granted 5 shi of grain.

s0513.literal: Anlong Stockade native official Cen Shizhong of Yunnan and his elder brother Shixing attacked each other; he registered thirty-two thousand households and submitted, offering three thousand bolts of cloth annually; he requested establishment of a pacification commission to oversee the area — not approved.
s0513.idiomatic: Anlong Stockade native official Cen Shizhong of Yunnan and his elder brother Shixing attacked each other; he registered 32,000 households and submitted, offering 3,000 bolts of cloth annually; he requested establishment of a pacification commission to oversee the area — not approved.

s0514.literal: One prefecture was established, with Shixing in charge of prefectural affairs; two counties were established, with Shizhong allowed to recommend appointees; they were also instructed to live together in harmony.
s0514.idiomatic: One prefecture was established, with Shixing in charge of prefectural affairs; 2 counties were established, with Shizhong allowed to recommend appointees; they were also instructed to live together in harmony.

s0515.literal: Two wanhu offices were established, commanding the Western Campaign Red Padded-Jacket Army.
s0515.idiomatic: Two wanhu offices were established, commanding the Western Campaign Red Padded-Jacket Army.

s0516.literal: Tash Temür and Dilqash said, "Calamities and portents have not ceased, due to dismissed officials who were removed for crimes bearing resentment and slander; we request they be appointed according to talent and ability.
s0516.idiomatic: Tash Temür and Dilqash said, "Calamities and portents have not ceased, due to dismissed officials who were removed for crimes bearing resentment and slander; we request they be appointed according to talent and ability.

s0518.literal: On xinwei day the spirit hall of Emperor Xianzong at the Great Tianyuan Yansheng Temple was completed; a commissioner office was established to manage revenues.
s0518.idiomatic: On xinwei day the spirit hall of Emperor Xianzong at the Great Tianyuan Yansheng Temple was completed; a commissioner office was established to manage revenues.

s0519.literal: On renshen day there was rain and haze.
s0519.idiomatic: On renshen day there was rain and haze.

s0520.literal: On jiaxu day the country of Yaji dispatched envoys presenting local products.
s0520.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the country of Yaji dispatched envoys presenting local products.

s0521.literal: On yimao day the Emperor attended Xingsheng Hall to receive the Amitayus Buddha precepts from the Imperial Preceptor.
s0521.idiomatic: On yimao day the Emperor attended Xingsheng Hall to receive the Amitayus Buddha precepts from the Imperial Preceptor.

s0522.literal: On gengchen day one thousand monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at Zhenguo Temple.
s0522.idiomatic: On gengchen day 1,000 monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at Zhenguo Temple.

s0523.literal: On xinsi day Princess Shouning was granted ten thousand strings of notes for salt prices.
s0523.idiomatic: On xinsi day Princess Shouning was granted 10,000 strings of notes for salt prices.

s0524.literal: On jiashen day Minister of Revenue Li Jianu was dispatched to Yanguan to sacrifice to the Sea God, and also to assemble deliberation on repairing the coast.
s0524.idiomatic: On jiashen day Minister of Revenue Li Jianu was dispatched to Yanguan to sacrifice to the Sea God, and also to assemble deliberation on repairing the coast.

s0525.literal: On bingxu day an edict directed the Imperial Preceptor to order monks to perform Buddhist rites at Yanguan Prefecture, and also to build two hundred sixteen pagodas to suppress seawater overflow.
s0525.idiomatic: On bingxu day an edict directed the Imperial Preceptor to order monks to perform Buddhist rites at Yanguan Prefecture, and also to build 216 pagodas to suppress seawater overflow.

s0526.literal: On wuzi day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0526.idiomatic: On wuzi day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0527.literal: On jichou day Zhao Shiyan was made superintendent of the Classics Colloquium; Zhao Jian was made associate superintendent; Aruwei was made deputy superintendent; Cao Yuanyong, Wu Bingdao, Yu Ji, Duan Fu, Ma Zuchang, Yanchi, and Bolu Chung were all additionally appointed Classics Colloquium officials.
s0527.idiomatic: On jichou day Zhao Shiyan was made superintendent of the Classics Colloquium; Zhao Jian was made associate superintendent; Aruwei was made deputy superintendent; Cao Yuanyong, Wu Bingdao, Yu Ji, Duan Fu, Ma Zuchang, Yanchi, and Bolu Chung were all additionally appointed Classics Colloquium officials.

s0528.literal: Yunnan native official Sajiabu submitted, presenting local products; one prefecture was established, with Sajiabu in charge of prefectural affairs, subordinate to the Luoluo Pacification Commission, and his rent and levies were collected.
s0528.idiomatic: Yunnan native official Sajiabu submitted, presenting local products; one prefecture was established, with Sajiabu in charge of prefectural affairs, subordinate to the Luoluo Pacification Commission, and his rent and levies were collected.

s0529.literal: On renchen day a woman of the Yang clan in Dangtu County, Taiping Route, gave birth to triplets.
s0529.idiomatic: On renchen day a woman of the Yang clan in Dangtu County, Taiping Route, gave birth to triplets.

s0530.literal: Jining and Weihui routes and Tai'an Prefecture suffered famine; forty-eight thousand three hundred ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0530.idiomatic: Jining and Weihui routes and Tai'an Prefecture suffered famine; 48,300 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

s0531.literal: Pingding Prefecture of Jining Route suffered famine; thirty thousand shi of grain was issued and sold at reduced prices.
s0531.idiomatic: Pingding Prefecture of Jining Route suffered famine; 30,000 shi of grain was issued and sold at reduced prices.

s0532.literal: Shaanxi, Sichuan, and Henan Prefecture and other places suffered famine; all were granted relief.
s0532.idiomatic: Shaanxi, Sichuan, and Henan Prefecture and other places suffered famine; all were granted relief.

s0533.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingshen day, Qin Prefecture Yao Huang Yan and others raided as bandits; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to prepare against them.
s0533.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on bingshen day, Qin Prefecture Yao Huang Yan and others raided as bandits; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to prepare against them.

s0534.literal: On jihai day Tash Temür and Dilqash requested that wherever Mongols and semu persons observed Han-style mourning for a parent, their names be removed from office — approved.
s0534.idiomatic: On jihai day Tash Temür and Dilqash requested that wherever Mongols and semu persons observed Han-style mourning for a parent, their names be removed from office — approved.

s0535.literal: On renyin day Li Jianu reported the proposal for building stone cribs to hold back the sea.
s0535.idiomatic: On renyin day Li Jianu reported the proposal for building stone cribs to hold back the sea.

s0536.literal: On jiyou day surveillance censor Yang Zhuo and others, citing famine among the people, requested distributing stored grain from monks and Daoists to relieve them — no response.
s0536.idiomatic: On jiyou day surveillance censor Yang Zhuo and others, citing famine among the people, requested distributing stored grain from monks and Daoists to relieve them — no response.

s0537.literal: On jiayin day Mount Meng Spirit was re-enfeoffed as King Jiahui Zhaoying; Salt Pond Spirit as Duke Lingfu; Dongting Shrine Spirit as King Zhonghui Shunli Lingji Zhaoyou; Tang Liuzhou prefect Liu Zongyuan as Duke Wenhui Zhaoling.
s0537.idiomatic: On jiayin day Mount Meng Spirit was re-enfeoffed as King Jiahui Zhaoying; Salt Pond Spirit as Duke Lingfu; Dongting Shrine Spirit as King Zhonghui Shunli Lingji Zhaoyou; Tang Liuzhou prefect Liu Zongyuan as Duke Wenhui Zhaoling.

s0538.literal: On wuwu day counterfeiting gold and silver vessels was prohibited.
s0538.idiomatic: On wuwu day counterfeiting gold and silver vessels was prohibited.

s0539.literal: Dependent prefectures and counties of Dadu, Dongchang, Daning, Bianliang, and Huaqing suffered famine; grain was issued in relief.
s0539.idiomatic: Dependent prefectures and counties of Dadu, Dongchang, Daning, Bianliang, and Huaqing suffered famine; grain was issued in relief.

s0540.literal: Dependent prefectures and counties of Baoding, Guanzhou, Dezhou, Panyang, Zhangde, and Jinan suffered famine; notes were issued in relief.
s0540.idiomatic: Dependent prefectures and counties of Baoding, Guanzhou, Dezhou, Panyang, Zhangde, and Jinan suffered famine; notes were issued in relief.

s0541.literal: That month, Lingzhou and Jun Prefecture had heavy hail.
s0541.idiomatic: That month, Lingzhou and Jun Prefecture had heavy hail.

s0542.literal: Jizhou and Qishan and Shicheng counties had locusts.
s0542.idiomatic: Jizhou and Qishan and Shicheng counties had locusts.

s0543.literal: Guangning Route suffered great flooding; Chongming Prefecture had strong wind and seawater overflow.
s0543.idiomatic: Guangning Route suffered great flooding; Chongming Prefecture had strong wind and seawater overflow.

s0544.literal: Fifth month, on jiazi day, officials were dispatched separately to escort displaced persons back to their home districts; gathering in groups of up to a thousand persons was still prohibited, with one hundred blows of the staff as punishment.
s0544.idiomatic: Fifth month, on jiazi day, officials were dispatched separately to escort displaced persons back to their home districts; gathering in groups of up to 1,000 persons was still prohibited, with 100 blows of the staff as punishment.

s0545.literal: On bingyin day the monk Chen Qing'an of Puning County, Guangxi, rebelled, presumptuously establishing a state and changing the era name.
s0545.idiomatic: On bingyin day the monk Chen Qing'an of Puning County, Guangxi, rebelled, presumptuously establishing a state and changing the era name.

s0546.literal: On jisi day Babai Xifuman dispatched his son Aizhao presenting a tame elephant.
s0546.idiomatic: On jisi day Babai Xifuman dispatched his son Aizhao presenting a tame elephant.

s0547.literal: On guiyou day disabled persons among displaced persons in the capital were registered, granted grain, and sent back.
s0547.idiomatic: On guiyou day disabled persons among displaced persons in the capital were registered, granted grain, and sent back.

s0548.literal: Dali Nujiang Prefecture native official A'aini raided Lezhu and other stockades; the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to supervise troops in capturing him.
s0548.idiomatic: Dali Nujiang Prefecture native official A'aini raided Lezhu and other stockades; the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to supervise troops in capturing him.

s0549.literal: On gengchen day a meteor as large as a jar appeared, its light illuminating the ground.
s0549.idiomatic: On gengchen day a meteor as large as a jar appeared, its light illuminating the ground.

s0550.literal: On jiashen day the kingdom of Annam and chieftains of the Eight-Cave tribes dispatched envoys presenting local products.
s0550.idiomatic: On jiashen day the kingdom of Annam and chieftains of the Eight-Cave tribes dispatched envoys presenting local products.

s0551.literal: On wuzi day Tash Temür, grand councillor of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat, was made central secretariat grand councillor.
s0551.idiomatic: On wuzi day Tash Temür, grand councillor of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat, was made central secretariat grand councillor.

s0552.literal: That month, Yanshan South, Shandong East Circuit, and Fengyuan, Datong, Hejian, Henan, Dongping, Puzhou and other places suffered famine; more than one hundred forty-three thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0552.idiomatic: That month, Yanshan South, Shandong East Circuit, and Fengyuan, Datong, Hejian, Henan, Dongping, Puzhou and other places suffered famine; more than 143,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

s0553.literal: Dependent counties of Xia Prefecture suffered famine; five thousand shi of grain was issued and sold at reduced prices in relief.
s0553.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Xia Prefecture suffered famine; 5,000 shi of grain was issued and sold at reduced prices in relief.

s0554.literal: Dependent counties of Jining, Guangping, and Zhending routes had heavy hail; Yingzhou of Runing Prefecture and Jixian of Weihui Route had locusts; Lingtai County of Jing Prefecture suffered drought.
s0554.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Jining, Guangping, and Zhending routes had heavy hail; Yingzhou of Runing Prefecture and Jixian of Weihui Route had locusts; Lingtai County of Jing Prefecture suffered drought.

s0555.literal: Sixth month, the Korean crown prince Wangzhetu petitioned for the return of his seal; grand councillor Mailü was dispatched to instruct the king of Goryeo to return it.
s0555.idiomatic: Sixth month, the Korean crown prince Wangzhetu petitioned for the return of his seal; grand councillor Mailü was dispatched to instruct the king of Goryeo to return it.

s0556.literal: On bingwu day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at Emperor Shizu's spirit hall.
s0556.idiomatic: On bingwu day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at Emperor Shizu's spirit hall.

s0557.literal: That month, in the various commanderies of Princes Nandash, Cheche Tu, Huosha, and Naimatai wind and snow killed livestock; soldiers suffered famine; fifty thousand shi of grain and four hundred thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0557.idiomatic: That month, in the various commanderies of Princes Nandash, Cheche Tu, Huosha, and Naimatai wind and snow killed livestock; soldiers suffered famine; 50,000 shi of grain and 400,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

s0558.literal: Fengyuan and Yan'an routes suffered famine; four thousand eight hundred ninety ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0558.idiomatic: Fengyuan and Yan'an routes suffered famine; 4,890 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

s0559.literal: Zhangde dependent counties had heavy hail; Nanning, Kaiyuan, and Yongping routes had flooding; dependent counties of Jiangling Route suffered drought; De'an garrison-farm in Henan had silk worms eating mulberry leaves.
s0559.idiomatic: Zhangde dependent counties had heavy hail; Nanning, Kaiyuan, and Yongping routes had flooding; dependent counties of Jiangling Route suffered drought; De'an garrison-farm in Henan had silk worms eating mulberry leaves.

s0560.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinyou new moon, Ningxia suffered an earthquake.
s0560.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on xinyou new moon, Ningxia suffered an earthquake.

s0561.literal: On gengwu day the Emperor died; he was thirty-six years old and was buried at Qinian Valley.
s0561.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Emperor died; he was 36 years old and was buried at Qinian Valley.

s0562.literal: On jimao day Daning Route suffered an earthquake.
s0562.idiomatic: On jimao day Daning Route suffered an earthquake.

s0563.literal: On guiwei day Buddhist rites were performed at Qinming Hall.
s0563.idiomatic: On guiwei day Buddhist rites were performed at Qinming Hall.

s0564.literal: On yiyou day the empress and crown prince issued directives reassuring and settling the common people.
s0564.idiomatic: On yiyou day the empress and crown prince issued directives reassuring and settling the common people.

s0565.literal: On bingxu day Venus transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.
s0565.idiomatic: On bingxu day Venus transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.

s0566.literal: Ninth month, Dilqash installed the crown prince as emperor, changed the era name to Tianshun, and proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0566.idiomatic: Ninth month, Dilqash installed the crown prince as emperor, changed the era name to Tianshun, and proclaimed throughout the realm.

s0567.literal: In the Taiding era calamities and portents appeared repeatedly; among ruler and ministers likewise no actual practice of accepting blame and examining oneself was seen — yet they knew how to adhere to ancestral laws in carrying out affairs; under Heaven there was no turmoil, and the age was called well governed — this is why it deserves to be regarded as sufficient grounds for praise.
s0567.idiomatic: In the Taiding era calamities and portents appeared repeatedly; among ruler and ministers likewise no actual practice of accepting blame and examining oneself was seen — yet they knew how to adhere to ancestral laws in carrying out affairs; under Heaven there was no turmoil, and the age was called well governed — this is why it deserves to be regarded as sufficient grounds for praise.
